usedFor: Shopify holds the store, and Alto receives a tracked video link for a shopper through “Create Recipient Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create Recipient Link” in Alto
bestTemplate.why: An abandoned checkout names one person, and the action makes a tracked link to one video for them.

watchOut: “Update Recipient Link” can turn a link off, so run it only from events you trust.
